# Deployment and containers

Explain container images, runtimes, networking, ports, health probes, runtime configuration and environment variables. Discuss simple, rolling, blue–green and canary releases; smoke checks, rollback and safe release verification.

Use students' actual provider and redacted logs when troubleshooting. Explain build vs runtime errors, connectivity, migrations, startup failures, missing variables and access-control differences between local and deployed APIs.

Discuss how deployment choices affect availability, SLA objectives, cost and fault tolerance.

**Boundary:** do not create Dockerfiles, Compose files, render.yaml, infrastructure scripts, deployment config or cloud resources. README text may document verified deployment steps, but not generate the configuration itself.
